subject: Social Media
title: What Cancellation Actually Means
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: What Cancellation Actually Means.

hook.text: 'Cancelled' means different things. For celebrities, it's bad press. For ordinary people, it's life-ending.

buildup.text: Most 'cancelled' celebrities recover. Louis C.K. sells out shows. J.K. Rowling still publishes bestsellers.

discovery.text: For ordinary people, it's far worse. A fired barista has no PR team or platform to rebuild from.

twist.text: The cancel debate hides the real issue: unequal power. The famous survive it. The unknown are crushed.

climax.text: Cancel culture isn't one thing. It's a spectrum from mild criticism to total social destruction.

punchline.text: Cancellation hits hardest where you'll never hear it.

quiz.question: Who is most affected by cancellation?
